description: The options around server-side grouping in a Svelte 5 data grid, each with the request log to show what it costs. A grand total row in any of four positions, subtotal footers per group, levels that open on arrival, expand-all that reaches groups not loaded yet, refresh in place versus purge, and the rules for what a sort or a filter re-requests: sorting a plain column re-fetches only the leaf levels, sorting a group column re-fetches that column's level alone, sorting an aggregated column re-fetches every level; a filter purges everything or, with onlyRefreshFilteredGroups, only the groups it touches.
keywords: svelte grid server side grouping options
svelte grid grand total row server
svelte 5 grid group footers subtotal server
svelte grid sort refresh levels server side
svelte grid expand all groups server

faq.question: Which levels does a sort re-fetch?
faq.answer: By default only the levels a sort can change. A plain column is not on a group row, so only leaf levels re-fetch. A group column changes the order of its own level and nothing beneath it, since the children of a group keep their own order. An aggregated column appears on every group row, so every level re-fetches. sortAllLevels turns the rule off and re-fetches everything.

faq.question: What is the difference between refresh and purge?
faq.answer: Refresh re-reads the open levels' loaded blocks in place: expansion, scroll position and row count survive, and the rows update under the user. Purge drops every cached level and starts over from the top level.

faq.question: How does expand everything reach groups that are not loaded?
faq.answer: expandAll({ includeUnloaded: true }) sets an auto-expand mode: every group row that arrives from then on opens on arrival, until the next collapseAll. It is the way to open a whole tree without knowing its shape in advance.
